title: Kurd Web
description: Kurd Web – build a complete RTL Kurdish website (Sorani or Badini) step by step: Header, Menu, Hero slider, Content and Footer, styled with Tailwind CSS.

title: Resend Migration Check: SendGrid code lint
description: Moving from Twilio SendGrid to Resend? Flags every @sendgrid/mail and sendgrid Python call, field and webhook event that has no 1:1 Resend equivalent, with the Resend line to write instead.

title: rf-detr Migration Check — Ultralytics YOLO ties
description: rf-detr migration check: flags Ultralytics YOLO (AGPL-3.0) ties in requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, environment.yml, Dockerfiles and Python code, with the Apache-2.0 RF-DETR line for each.

title: SkiaSharp Migration Check for ImageSharp
description: Flags SixLabors ImageSharp 3+, Drawing 2+, Fonts 2+ and ImageSharp.Web 3+ references that fall under the Six Labors Split License, with the SkiaSharp (MIT) replacement for each line.

title: VSCodium Migration Lint: Microsoft-only Extensions
description: VSCodium migration check: flags extensions in .vscode/extensions.json and devcontainer.json that Microsoft licenses for VS Code only or that Open VSX lacks, with the open replacement ID

title: Pixel Clarity — FITS, HDF5 & NumPy image viewer
description: Inspect FITS, NumPy, HDF5 and TIFF images in VS Code: zscale, stretches, colormaps, histogram, region stats and cuts. Built for Remote-SSH: data and statistics stay on the remote, only the tiles you look at cross the link.
